items.name: Ball Shot
items.ruleText: Swivel Gun ammunition, lasting one game when used; buy a new supply afterward. Range 36 inches, S5, -2 armour save; Injury rolls 2-4 stun. Declare ammunition before firing.

items.name: Chain Shot
items.ruleText: Swivel Gun ammunition, lasting one game when used. Range 24 inches, S4, -1 armour save. An unwounded hit target is knocked down on 4+, even if normally immune to knockdown. Declare ammunition before firing.

items.name: Grape Shot
items.ruleText: Swivel Gun ammunition, lasting one game when used. Range 24 inches, S3, no armour modifier. A hit also hits D6 other enemies within 4 inches of the target and in the firer's sight, nearest first, including hidden models. If the original target is in the open, models in cover are excluded; friendly Pirates are never hit. Declare ammunition before firing.

items.name: Hook Hand
items.ruleText: A new Pirate may start with one. Counts as a dagger in that hand and forbids two-handed weapons; later Hand Injury or Arm Wound is ignored on 4+ if taken by the hook.

items.name: Boat Hook
items.ruleText: Close combat at user Strength -1. Two-handed; strikes first in the first round regardless of who charged. Cannot combine with another weapon, shield or buckler in close combat.

items.name: Toughened leathers
items.ruleText: 6+ armour save; cannot combine with other armour except a helmet or buckler. Cannot resell after a battle.

items.name: Belaying Pin
items.ruleText: Thrown weapon, range 6 inches, user Strength -1. No range penalty, but moving still gives -1 to hit. Target gains +1 armour save, or 6+ if unarmoured.

items.name: Hook Hand
items.ruleText: A new Pirate may start with one. Counts as a dagger in that hand and forbids two-handed weapons; later Hand Injury or Arm Wound is ignored on 4+ if taken by the hook.

specialRules.name: Swabbies
specialRules.summary: Only humans may join as Swabbies; special recruitment mechanics apply.

specialRules.name: Kidnapped
specialRules.summary: A captured human Hero may join Pirates after a post-battle Leadership contest; otherwise the captive becomes a Swabbie.

specialRules.name: Pit Fighter
specialRules.summary: All Pit Fighters gain +1 WS and +1 Attack in ruins, buildings, and the Pit.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.summary: May hire all available Hired Swords except the Elf Ranger.

hiredSwordPolicy.summary: May hire all available Hired Swords except the Elf Ranger.

items.name: Ithilmar dagger
items.ruleText: Heroes only; twice ordinary cost.

items.name: Ithilmar double-handed weapon
items.ruleText: Heroes only; twice ordinary cost.

items.name: Ithilmar spear
items.ruleText: Heroes only; twice ordinary cost.

items.name: Ithilmar sword
items.ruleText: Heroes only; twice ordinary cost.

items.name: Ithilmar armour
items.ruleText: Heroes only; source starting price. Later use ordinary Trading Post price and rarity.

items.name: Standard of Nagarythe
items.ruleText: Heroes only; may only be purchased at warband creation, with no rarity roll. Shadow Warriors within 12 inches reroll failed Leadership tests; Hired Swords are unaffected. Losing the bearer out of action gives the band hatred and prohibits voluntary routing for the remaining battle. Requires a free hand; may fight as a spear at -1 to hit.

items.name: War Horn of Nagarythe
items.ruleText: Heroes only; fixed starting price, no rarity roll. Once per battle, use at turn start or before a Rout test to give the band +1 Leadership until the next turn begins. Later price is 25+D6 gc, Rare 6.

items.name: Elven Cloak
items.ruleText: Fixed starting price, no rarity roll; not marked Heroes only in the source list. Shooting at the wearer suffers -1 to hit.

items.name: Elven Wine
items.ruleText: Heroes only to purchase; fixed starting price, no rarity roll. Drinking before a battle makes the warband immune to fear for that battle. Later price is 50+3D6 gc, Rare 10.

items.name: Elven Runestones
items.ruleText: Source list marks Heroes only; item rules require a mage, so restrict to Shadow Weaver. Fixed starting price, no rarity roll. Attempt to dispel a successful spell against a band member by matching its Difficulty; Sorcery does not help. Later price is 50+2D6 gc, Rare 11.

specialRules.name: Hate Dark Elves
specialRules.summary: Warband members other than Hired Swords hate Dark Elves.

specialRules.name: Excellent Sight
specialRules.summary: Elves spot hidden enemies at twice their Initiative in inches.

specialRules.name: Distaste for Poison
specialRules.summary: Warriors may not use poisons.

specialRules.name: Unforgiving
specialRules.summary: Cannot ally with warbands of a Chaotic nature.

specialRules.name: Concussion
specialRules.summary: Injury rolls 2-4 stun.

specialRules.name: Holy Weapon
specialRules.summary: +1 to wound against Possessed or Undead; critical wounds still require an unmodified 6.

specialRules.name: Paired warhammers
specialRules.summary: Only Matriarchs and Sister Superiors may carry two.

specialRules.name: Cannot be parried
specialRules.summary: Swords and bucklers cannot parry its attacks.

specialRules.name: Whipcrack
specialRules.summary: When charging, gain one additional attack that turn. When charged, gain one strike-first attack usable only against a charger. Multiple chargers or a second whip do not add further Whipcrack attacks.

items.name: Holy tome
items.ruleText: Heroines only; fixed recruitment price instead of the later 100+D6x10 gc. A Sister or Warrior Priest using the tome adds +1 to prayer-casting rolls; owning it does not grant prayers.

items.name: Blessed water
items.ruleText: Heroines only; fixed recruitment price. Single-use thrown attack at twice the thrower's Strength in inches, using BS without movement or range penalties. A hit automatically causes one wound on Undead, Daemon or Possessed models, with no armour save.

items.name: Holy relic
items.ruleText: Heroines only; fixed recruitment price. Automatically pass the first Leadership test required in the battle, including the leader's first Rout test if she has made no earlier Leadership test. Extra relics do not allow further automatic passes.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.summary: Causes Fear.

specialRules.name: Burn the Witch!
specialRules.summary: Witch Hunters hate all models able to cast spells.

specialRules.name: Burn the Witch!
specialRules.summary: Hates all models able to cast spells.

specialRules.name: Burn the Witch!
specialRules.summary: Hates all models able to cast spells.
